intro: House painting in San Antonio with over 20 years of experience. About 70% of our time goes into prep, and it shows in the finish.
servicesIntro: One room or the whole property.

services.name: Interior painting
services.text: Walls, ceilings, baseboards, crown moldings, doors and rooms of every kind, from kitchens to bedrooms.

services.name: Exterior painting
services.text: Wood siding, stucco, eaves, shutters, gates and garage doors, prepped and painted.

services.name: Cabinet refinishing
services.text: Kitchen cabinets and handrails refinished with careful masking and a smooth finish.

services.name: Texture and faux finishes
services.text: Textured walls and faux finishes that give a kitchen, living room or bedroom its own character.

services.name: Repairs and prep
services.text: Drywall repairs, wood damage repairs, wallpaper removal and acoustic removal before any paint goes on.

services.name: Staining and deck restoration
services.text: Staining, deck restoration and pressure washing for wood and outdoor spaces.

why.name: Prep comes first
why.text: About 70% of our time goes into preparation, and it shows in the finished product.

why.name: Over 20 years of experience
why.text: Everlast Pro Painting has served the San Antonio area for more than two decades.

why.name: Owner involved
why.text: Clients say owner Patrick Overby is responsive, visits the job and keeps the crew on schedule.

howTitle: A fresh coat in three steps.

steps.name: Call for a free estimate
steps.text: We look at the work, ask questions and give you a flat price.

steps.name: We prep and paint
steps.text: We mask, scrape, caulk and prime, then paint. We buy all the supplies.

steps.name: Pay when it is done
steps.text: On most jobs, you pay nothing until everything is completely finished.

reviews.text: Patrick and his team had the tough task of refinishing our new kitchen cabinets that had been almost ruined by our last painter. The cabinets came out beautifully, and look like they have a factory finish on them! I knew they were the right team from the start. Their attention to detail starting with the masking of the kitchen was unlike other painters I have used in the past. The cabinets and trim turned out so great we had them paint the exterior too! The house has been completely transformed. I will definitely be using them again.
reviews.name: Michael

reviews.text: Everlast painted the exterior of my home as well as the shed. Patrick, the owner, is very involved and very concerned with customer happiness. He was easy to reach and visited our home daily. His crew did an excellent job and cleaned up every day. Would highly recommend this company.
reviews.name: Megan

reviews.text: When their work is complete, it is nearly impossible to tell that there have been any repairs done. … They show up when they say they will, finish on schedule and clean up at the end.
reviews.name: Jim H.
